text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Wheeeew!! That was a fantastic workout~!"

Summer training camp had arrived. Seeking the Pearl was
sailing smoothly through her training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, it's free time from here on out!
Let us enjoy the festival!"
choice_data_list: Do you mean the summer festival nearby?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"No! Something on a far more global scale!
Here, this is your invitation. Check it out and come on!!"

I made my way to the beach indicated on the invitation.
There shouldn't have been any festival scheduled around here, but—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Ohohoho!
Welcome, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Haaaap!!"
Seeking the Pearl leaped down with dashing flair?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Seeking the Pearl presents!
A global carnival of love and hope... STAAART!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Delivering passion straight from the Land of the Sun!
Come on, let the music move you!"

Swept along by Seeking the Pearl's invitation,
I found myself busting out dance steps without even knowing what I was doing...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"What's up, Trainer?!
Say, HOOO-OH!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my! Look at you, all fired up, Trainer!!
Time to cool you down♪"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"An Asian summer festival to blast away the heat!
Let's SHOOT!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Now, behold as the dream continues! Rocket MAGIC!"
*(Fweee, fweee, fweee!!)*

Bottle rockets crisscrossed through the twilight sky.
I was left in pure, speechless awe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A rocket fireworks show beloved all across the globe!
Packed with good fortune, this entire year is set to be smooth sailing♪"
choice_data_list: I can't even keep up anymore?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The main dish starts now!
Come, to the deserted island!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Fufufu, the stars are beginning to show. Absolutely beautiful..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, what I wish to deliver to you is a brilliance far greater.
Something so radiant you can't help reaching out for it—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "—A blazing jewel."

Seeking the Pearl gave a signal.
A high-pitched whistle rang out—
—and fireworks like glistening gemstones illuminated the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Now for the finale.
Accept my true feelings—"
As the firework burst overhead, large letters formed in the sky—
"U O Y K N A H T"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Well, what do you think?
...Wait, NOOO?! It's completely backward!!"

Seeing that message made me understand the point
of this whole festival. However—
choice_data_list: Did I really do anything worth thanking me for?
Did I do anything to deserve that much thanks?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Fufu, you truly don't realize it yourself, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I have a habit of making mistakes from time to time, just like now, don't I?
And whenever that happens... you're always there to back me up."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It was the same when I tried to help the bento shop.
I was completely fixated on spreading the word to as many people as possible."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it hit me so hard when I realized you'd arranged the food truck
and helped the Master regain his confidence."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I... always charge ahead all on my own.
And you've always been there to support me through it... Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Today's festival was my way of showing my gratitude.
...Even if it didn't turn out quite flawless."
choice_data_list: Your feelings came through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I hated making a mistake.
Fufu, I'll have to make it up to you someday."

Seeking the Pearl reflected on herself, thinking she'd only been looking straight ahead.
However... there was no need for that.

I wanted Seeking the Pearl to keep charging ahead toward the world.
Driven by her passion, staying true to her convictions. That's why—
choice_data_list: I want you to keep only looking forward from now on, too.
I want you to keep looking ahead, just like you always have.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Trainer... Oh, you really are something else...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Bravo! 'Keep moving forward,' you say?!
Could there possibly be a more magnificent plan than that!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "I wouldn't have it any other way! Let us charge ahead to the ends of the earth!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Running in races all across the globe, on and on and on...
Reaching the pinnacle of them all is no mere fantasy!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we're not done yet!
If we keep moving forward, we can go beyond this world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Like say, racing on the surface of the moon against space horsegirls!
Fufufu, the dream just keeps growing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because you're right by my side!
We can bring endless possibilities to life!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, your words are my energy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's shine even brighter together from here on out.
More than anyone else in the whole world...

The future holds things beyond our wildest imagination.
Even so, I'll always be standing by her side... That much is certain.
